turns.question: It's the end of 7 October 2026. How many customers who signed up in 2026 have never placed an order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for customers who signed up in 2026 and never placed an order, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Signups (new customers counted on the day they signed up), Active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order) and Signup-to-first-order rate (share of customers who ordered within 30 days of signing up); no query was run, so there is no freshness statement for this answer.
